title: Finish the two-loop migration: loop:seal-feedback still requires a per-cycle playtest
body:
The two-loop split removed the per-cycle playtest gate from the dev loop, but only
half the migration landed. `loop.sh` is migrated: `require_playtest_record` is gone
(tests/regression/loop_driver_gates.test.ts:444 asserts its absence),
`report_qa_bucket` can never fail a cycle, and loop.sh:331 even comments "the fence
is still worth keeping now that the run is gone".

Two places still require the run:

1. `scripts/seal-feedback-acceptance.ts` (~337-381) unconditionally reads
   ai-runs/<runId>/playtest.md, playtest.evidence.jsonl and playtest.run.json,
   re-runs verifyCyclePlaytest, and demands a schema_version 2, play_mode "pure"
   sidecar whose build.git_commit equals the provisional HEAD. Any of those missing
   calls fail(), the npm script exits nonzero, and loop.sh:540 fires
   _reject_cycle "final-commit" -> git reset --hard.
2. `src/ai-loop.ts` (~389-391) still emits "STEP 3 — Play the provisional revision
   from a fresh overworld" with `npm run blind`.

So a correctly-configured loop works. The trap is for anyone who trusts the charter:
a commit-mode cycle that skips the playtest passes pre-crawl, the change,
post-crawl, health and integrity, and is then hard-reset at the seal. After five
such cycles the breaker stops the loop and five verified changes are gone.

WHY THIS WAS NOT JUST DONE

The seal does two jobs at once: verifying the cycle playtest, and sealing the
feedback acceptance manifest into AI_LOOP_STATE.md. reportId is derived from the
sidecar (`pure:${hashState(sidecar)}`) and feeds pending_cycle_reports, so removing
the playtest requirement is not a deletion — it is a change to the feedback ledger's
evidence model. tests/unit/seal_feedback_acceptance.test.ts (1,021 lines) and
tests/unit/cycle_playtest_gate.test.ts deliberately pin the current contract.

That makes this an owner decision about evidence authority, not a defect fix:

  Option A — finish the migration. Make the cycle playtest artifacts optional in the
  seal (verify them exactly as now when present, seal the manifest alone when
  absent), drop STEP 3 from the commit-mode prompt, and rework the two test files.
  Under the two-loop design, pending_cycle_reports becomes vestigial: reports arrive
  from the playtest loop, not from the dev cycle.

  Option B — keep the gate and revert the claim. Say plainly in AGENTS.md, README
  and docs/two_loop_workflow.md that the dev loop still plays once per commit-mode
  cycle, and that the split bought parallel VOLUME rather than an unblocked dev loop.

Documentation now states the half-migrated truth rather than either end state, so
nobody is burned in the meantime.
